title: OpenAI token counting guide

limitation: plain encoding counts are not billed request usage; model, message role and tool overhead can differ

title: OpenAI prompt caching guide
limitation: cache use does not reduce the request context itself and hit behavior depends on matching prefixes and provider conditions

title: RFC 8878: Zstandard Compression
limitation: a model normally needs decompressed text; compressed bytes and base64 do not imply fewer model tokens

title: RFC 8949: Concise Binary Object Representation
limitation: requires a decoder and is not a directly readable prompt representation

title: TOON Format Specification
scope: repeated fields and uniform object arrays in prompts
limitation: working-draft external format; token benefit and model comprehension require USL-specific measurement

title: LLMLingua-2: Data Distillation for Efficient and Faithful Task-Agnostic Prompt Compression
limitation: can omit information, so it cannot be a lossless USL core representation or mandatory dependency
